raw_segments.text: There are fields and fields of flowers, she said, forgetting herself, as usual when she
began, and talking rather as if she were in a dream.
Fields and fields of Lily's end, when the soft wind blows over them, it wafts the scent
of them into the air and everybody always breathes it, because the soft wind is always
blowing, and little children run about in the Lily fields and gather armfuls of them,
and laugh and make little wreaths, and the streets are shining.
And people are never tired, however far they walk.
They can float anywhere they like.
And there are walls made of pearl and gold all around the city, but they are low enough
